title: redactSecrets
responsibility: Replace anything shaped like a credential, token, private key or secret file path with a fixed marker before text reaches Slack, a model or a tool result.

inputs.name: redactSecrets.text
inputs.description: Untrusted text that may contain credentials or secret file paths.

outputs.name: redactSecrets
outputs.description: The same text with each credential-shaped span replaced by [redacted].
